title.narrative: Local Public Safety Integrated Management Program
Programa de Gestin Integrada Local de Seguridad Ciudadana

description.narrative: The general objective of this program is to help reduce violent crime in the city of Montevideo through specific prevention actions in three territories and their vulnerable populations. The specific objectives are: (i) to make the police force more effective in crime prevention and clearance in the selected territories; and (ii) to enhance the rehabilitation of juveniles who exhibit high risk factors associated with violence and crime in the program target areas.
